small_guidance:
- The fused softmax-sub-swish-max kernel is already lightweight; the bottleneck is the ConvTranspose3d (torch fallback). Tuning BLOCK_C/num_warps further on the tail kernel will not move fast_p meaningfully.
- If keeping the tail kernel, try num_warps=4 with BLOCK_C=16 (exact C) and fuse the MaxPool3d into the same kernel by gathering the 2x2x2 window per output element, eliminating one full read/write pass.
- Consider channels_last3d layout for the post-conv tensor so the softmax/max-over-C loads coalesce contiguously.
large_guidance:
- Replace nn.ConvTranspose3d with a custom Triton scatter-add kernel: one program per (N, IC tile, input-spatial tile), computing the input×weight outer product and scatter-adding into the output grid with proper stride=2/padding=1/output_padding=1 index math. This is the dominant cost (~20ms vs 6ms baseline) and the highest-headroom target.
- Fuse the trailing MaxPool3d (k=2,s=2), softmax-over-C, subtract, swish, and max-over-C into a single epilogue kernel reading the conv output once: one program per (N, output-spatial-after-pool) loading C×8 elements, doing the pool max, then the channel softmax/swish/max in registers.
- Precompute and store the conv bias folded into the kernel; pass weight in (IC, OC, kD, kH, kW) layout so the K dimension (IC*kD*kH*kW) is contiguous for the GEMM-K loads. Use BLOCK_OC=16 (matches out_channels) so OC fits in one tile.
